title: HCES simulated poverty below Rs 3,000/month by social group, 2023-24
sourceIndicatorId: HCES 2023-24 unit-level microdata: MPCE cutoff simulation

metadata.provenance: Computed from HCES 2023-24 unit-level microdata, calibrated to published national rural and urban average MPCE.
metadata.method: For each cutoff, compute the population-weighted share of people living in households with reconstructed MPCE below the monthly rupee cutoff. This is a sensitivity simulation, not an official poverty estimate.
metadata.caveat: Cutoffs are nominal 2023-24 rupees per person per month. Results depend on MPCE reconstruction, reference-period scaling and calibration.
